# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Clear centering of modal dialog
- Logical vertical flow of elements
- Proper spacing between components
- Good balance between content and negative space

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (≥4.5:1)
- Borders and interactive elements have sufficient contrast (≥3:1)
- Color coding effectively communicates status (recommended vs experimental)

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- Hover states visible on all interactive elements
- Active states properly indicated
- Focus-visible styles applied to all controls
- Visual feedback for checkbox interaction

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- Clear labels and instructions
- Proper error prevention through modal design
- Appropriate placeholder text
- Focus management works correctly

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Current location clearly indicated (PLAY tab highlighted)
- Clear back path via CANCEL button
- Logical tab order

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- Modal indicates current state (render engine selection)
- No empty states present in current view

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- Clear messaging about experimental features
- Recovery path via CANCEL button
- No error states present in current view

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- All interactive elements have proper ARIA labels
- Full keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader compatibility
- Proper focus management

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- Consistent component styling throughout
- Uniform button design
- Consistent typography and spacing

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- No visual noise or unnecessary elements
- Clean, focused interface
- Only essential controls visible

## Issues Found:

[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Low] [WCAG 2.2 AA] Missing ARIA label for "Don't show this again" checkbox | Impact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of this control | Fix: Add `aria-label="Don't show this render engine selection dialog again"` to the checkbox element

[ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: Low] [Nielsen's Heuristics] No visual indication of the current selection state in the render engine options | Impact: Users may not know which option is currently selected | Fix: Add a selected state indicator (e.g., background highlight) to the currently chosen render engine option

[ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: Low] [Fitts's Law] CANCEL button positioned far from primary action buttons | Impact: Increased time to cancel operation | Fix: Move CANCEL button closer to the render engine options or align horizontally with them

[ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Low] [Hick's Law] No default selection for render engine | Impact: Users must make an additional decision | Fix: Set Sodium as the default selected option with visual indication

[ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Low] [Law of Proximity] "Don't show this again" checkbox separated from its label | Impact: Reduced association between control and text | Fix: Move the label text closer to the checkbox or use a more compact layout

[ISSUE #6] [SEVERITY: Low] [Aesthetic-Usability Effect] Inconsistent icon sizing between render engine options | Impact: Slight visual imbalance | Fix: Standardize icon dimensions (e.g., 24x24px for both Sodium and VulkanMod icons)

[ISSUE #7] [SEVERITY: Low] [Recognition over Recall] No visual cue for what happens when "Don't show this again" is checked | Impact: Users may hesitate to use this feature | Fix: Add a tooltip or brief explanation text near the checkbox

## Overall Assessment:
The Minecraft launcher interface demonstrates excellent UI/UX design with only minor issues that don't significantly impact usability. The design follows accessibility standards and usability principles effectively, with clear visual hierarchy, proper contrast, and intuitive interaction patterns. The modal dialog for render engine selection is particularly well-designed, providing clear choices with appropriate visual cues for recommended vs experimental options.
